name: djs
description: D diagnostics, hovers, completion and highlighting from the D frontend itself: djs, the LDC 1.43.0 frontend ported to TypeScript, running inside VS Code with no D toolchain installed

djs.ldc2Line.markdownDescription: The ldc2 command line your build uses for this repository (for example `ldc2 -i -Isrc -Jviews --vcolumns -mtriple=aarch64-linux-gnu --preview=dip1000 -d-debug`). The compile keeps its compile-defining flags, `-i` included, and drops the build-only ones (`-c`, `-of`, `-L`, `-g`, `--deps`, the inputs). Empty: the default line `ldc2 -i -I<folder>`, plus `-I<folder>/source` and `-I<folder>/src` where those directories exist (dub's layouts); the status bar then says `default line`.

djs.ldcRoot.markdownDescription: An ldc2 1.43.0 install (its root, holding `import/object.d`) whose import tree replaces the LDC 1.43.0 tree bundled with djs. Empty: the bundled tree.

djs.target.markdownDescription: The target when `djs.ldc2Line` has no `-mtriple`: `aarch64-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-linux-gnu`, or an arm64 Mac triple (`arm64-apple-darwin`, with its Darwin version, `arm64-apple-darwin24.0.0`, or a macOS one, `arm64-apple-macos15`). Empty: the host's (an arm64 Mac, or Linux on aarch64 or x86_64; djs refuses other hosts without a target).

djs.compileOnPause.markdownDescription: Compile a D file of the workspace after a pause in typing (`#djs.compileOnPauseDelay#`), from the editor's text, without saving it: the diagnostics, hovers, tokens and hints follow the unsaved text. Every compile, a save's too, reads the open D files with unsaved edits from the editor. A compile in progress is not interrupted; the next one compiles the latest text.

djs.compileOnPauseDelay.markdownDescription: The pause in typing, in milliseconds, after which `#djs.compileOnPause#` compiles the edited file; a value below 50 counts as 50.

djs.semanticTokens.markdownDescription: Colour each identifier of a D file by what it names in the last compile (namespace, type, function, variable, parameter, member, enum member; `readonly`, `static`, `deprecated`, `defaultLibrary`), over the grammar's colours. The tokens are those of the last compile; while the file has edits not yet compiled the editor keeps the previous ones.

djs.inlayHints.types.markdownDescription: Show the type the last compile inferred: `: T` after a variable declared without one (`auto x`, `const x = 1`, a `foreach` variable), `-> T` after the parameters of a function whose return type is inferred.

djs.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show the parameter's name before each argument of a call (`name:`), on the overload the last compile picked; not when the argument is that name already.

djs.inlayHints.instanceCounts.markdownDescription: Show after a template's name how many instances the last compile created of it, the first ones in the tooltip; nothing for a template with none.

djs.dimInactiveCode.markdownDescription: Dim the branches of `version`, `debug` and `static if` the last compile did not choose for this repository's target and flags (`djs.ldc2Line`).

djs.inactiveCodeOpacity.markdownDescription: The opacity of the branches `djs.dimInactiveCode` dims, from 0 (hidden) to 1 (not dimmed).

djs.expansionLenses.markdownDescription: Show a code lens over each construct the last compile expanded (a string mixin, a template instance, a folded value); clicking it peeks at the expansion, as **djs: Show Expansion** does at the cursor.

scripts.bundle: esbuild extension/extension.cts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension/extension.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild host/compiler.ts host/flags.ts host/ast.ts host/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outdir=dist/host --log-level=warning
scripts.package: vsce package --no-dependencies --readme-path extension/README.md --changelog-path extension/CHANGELOG.md -o "${DJS_VSCODE_SCRATCH:?set DJS_VSCODE_SCRATCH to the output directory}/"
